name: Janus Strategic Distance
squared_weight_scale: q_j = view_share / (3 * number_of_features_in_block); each block totals 1/3

archetypes.selection_rule: smallest K at or after knee meeting joint worst-race/pole 95th-percentile tolerances in optimization and local robustness; all those fits must converge

tolerance_interpretation.membership: fraction of mixture mass reassigned; .20 means 20 percentage points
tolerance_interpretation.pole: displacement divided by nearest other reference pole distance; .25 means one quarter of that separation
